documentLimitations: Codex retains apply_patch availability; read-only sandbox blocks writes. Shell/browser/app/plugin features are disabled and any attempted tool use rejects the result. This is not a blanket tool-free CLI.
Source references sharing identical document bytes are not independent corroboration.

checks.reason: Strict extraction claim schema
Every supporting quote is an exact contiguous source excerpt
Source quotation names the registry municipality; source binding separately checked
Title preserves exact source characters/token order; display whitespace may collapse
Authority identifier is quoted or explicit source-document fallback
Document date occurs in its quote, not retrieval metadata
Stage date occurs in its quote
Original status is exact supporting source wording; unknown remains unknown
Historical stage wording and dates have source quotations
Preparatory votes/consultation and future announcements cannot become final adoption, legal effect or completed works
Budget allocations and planned expenditure are not evidence of actual spending
Canonical hierarchical topic IDs and actual assignment provenance
Entity labels preserve source characters/token order with display-only whitespace collapse
Location labels preserve source characters/token order with display-only whitespace collapse; no geocoding
Geometry requires exact explicit GeoJSON in source; no inferred coordinates
Every non-date numeric token is literal source evidence; valid calendar dates may use equivalent ISO, numeric or German month spelling
No extracted email/phone contact details
Unique typed non-person mentions have exact source quotations and whitespace-equivalent labels; no metadata-only entities.
Identifier, namespace, issuer and named entity share a source quote; conflicting identifiers within one namespace are rejected.
Both named endpoints and an explicit typed predicate occur in one contiguous quotation; time and conditions are quoted, not metadata-derived.
Negation, future/proposal and conditions cannot be promoted to asserted graph edges; historical claims retain quoted time.

faithfulness.reason: Identity, title, summary, dates, and decision stage are supported; the 12 December date is explicitly tied to the council decision. Topics are broad but plausible. No unsupported graph claims.
faithfulness.limitation: Same-model judgment is not independent verification.
